📖 How to get an API Key?

1️⃣ Open openrouter.ai and sign up
2️⃣ Go to "Keys" and create an API Key
3️⃣ Paste the sk-or-v1- key below
4️⃣ Try free models first, switch in "Model" later
Optional, leave empty to use built-in key
